name: Echoes of War
source:
“You’ve got two months to pack up and leave.” That’s what your landlord says. Since losing your job, you’ve sold everything just to survive – furniture, art, even clothes. It’s never enough. 

Then a letter arrives: your great-uncle, a man you barely knew, has died and left you his manor. When you arrive, the place is cold and lifeless. Dust coats the walls. Something moves in the dark.

To claim your new home, you must uncover the truth buried in its war-torn past. Are you ready?

[From [url=https://wannacrytroj.itch.io/echoes-of-war]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你有两个月的时间收拾行李离开。”这就是你房东说的。自从失业后，为了生存，你卖掉了一切——家具、艺术品，甚至衣服。这永远不够。

然后一封信到达：你的叔祖父，一个你几乎不认识的人，去世了，把他的庄园留给了你。当你到达时，这个地方寒冷且毫无生气。墙壁上布满了灰尘。黑暗中有东西在移动。

为了占领你的新家园，你必须揭开埋藏在饱受战争蹂躏的过去的真相。你准备好了吗？

[来自[url=https://wannacrytroj.itch.io/echoes-of-war]Itch.io[/url]]
